items.title: bioMérieux holds £1.29m bridging contract for Dorset's microbiology pathology service
items.summary: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded bioMérieux a two-year, £1,285,884 contract to continue its Pathology Managed Service for Microbiology while the Southern Counties Pathology network implements the new Molecular Diagnostics Lot 5.
